name: FactList
description: A semantic description list: compact label and value pairs for popovers, metadata and small summaries, or aligned rows for a record's details.

props.name: facts
props.description: Compact label/value rows, in reading order.

props.name: variant
props.description:
`compact`: each label sits beside its value, for popovers and small summaries. `rows`: a
property list for a record's details panel, with an icon column when any fact has an icon, a
label column every value starts after, and a hairline between rows. Values are centred on
the row, so chips and badges line up with their labels; the label column narrows in a narrow
container.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
